title: QA (pytest): packaging 22+ removes LegacyVersion
summary: A dependency bump (packaging 21.3 -> 24.1) removes the LegacyVersion class the release-tag sorter imports (alibi-qa controlled scenario).

expected.notes: packaging 22.0 removed LegacyVersion, so the test module fails to import. A model change to packaging 22.0 still fails validation; the deterministic pin back to 21.3 validates.
